name: Acer Medical Inc.
summary: Acer Medical Inc. is a company dedicated to the healthcare industry, providing advanced solutions that incorporate artificial intelligence, clinical data analysis, and specialized software. Their product lineup features VeriSee DR, an AI-powered diagnostic tool for detecting diabetic retinopathy; VeriSee AMD, an AI-enabled screening application focused on identifying age-related macular degeneration; and VeriOsteo OP, an AI-assisted screening software used to detect anomalies in bone mineral density. The company was established in 2018 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
